description: Closed vocabulary for abstract nodes in stencil topology. Role types are domain-agnostic; domain nouns belong in full_shape.domain_skin only.
principle: Agents assign role_type from this list. Code assigns stable role_id on canonicalization.

role_types.description: Origin of flow, input, or activation energy
Transforms or routes between other roles without being the origin or terminus
Background conditioning layer that warps accessibility without changing core identity
Perceived navigable topology shaped by context or constraints
Active search or traversal agent moving through a space
Reusable structural pattern to be matched or instantiated
Antisymmetric or inverse configuration used for guardrails
Connects previously separated regions; phase-transition carrier
Stock that accumulates or depletes over time
Background process that develops latent connections before conscious reveal
